name: clock-73h-ahead
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile with the pump's clock set 73 hours ahead on its screen 180 minutes ago (TimeChanged and DateChange records). It ends 73 hours ahead of the phone, past a 24-hour trust limit, so the app has to set it; a bolus read while the clock is that far off is a case TandemKit still misdates (conformance G7, G16). Before it, a 2.0 U pump bolus 240 minutes ago and a 150% temp rate from 200 minutes ago that runs across it (its start is stamped on the old clock, its end on the new); after it, a 1.0 U pump bolus 90 minutes ago. The change is in the log, so every record can be dated to the instant it was written.
